text: Sarah thought she was being a culinary genius by adding chili powder to her cookies, but her kitchen skills took a sharp turn for the absurd when she confused salt for sugar. The result wasn't a spicy kick, but a bizarre "sweet and salty surprise" that left her friends chugging milk just to survive the flavor profile. It’s a classic case of mixing up ingredients, proving that sometimes the only thing spicier than the recipe is the regret on your face when you realize you just baked a salted caramel disaster.
